notes.title: Unsolved Stories Development Version 1.5 Update
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

We released Unsolved Stories Development Version 1.5 today.

We want to share some information and reminders right away. About a week ago, we officially kicked off the update season and announced that we'd be completing the open-world map in stages.

In a remarkably short time, we've rapidly progressed from a small beginning to a quickly expanding area. A huge thank you to everyone who supports this project – we truly appreciate it.

Full Map Planning
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32004930/5fe666947de0a380c84f2099b86fa185fa689a87.jpg[/img]

In this image, you can see the plan for the complete game map, as well as its location in Region 06 and the area it covers. Our goal is to open the entire massive map by the end of this month. We want to remind you that we're working intensely every day on object optimization and placement.


Development Version 1.5 Screenshot 1
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32004930/cd94336eda2b32d9199a6c89d7556a535ce5ce22.jpg[/img]

Development Version 1.5 Screenshot 2
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32004930/a8ebe00c703668613e63f942542214df44e96f0f.jpg[/img]

It's important for players to keep this in mind: if you want to support this project, please understand that it's an unfinished game and still in the development phase.

Note: The game will continue to be developed with daily updates, and we may occasionally miss update news.

notes.title: Unsolved Stories Development Version 1.0 Update.
notes.content:
"Hello everyone,

We're excited to announce the conclusion of a period of focused development and share an update on the project's progress. We sincerely thank everyone who has supported the game throughout this time.

Here's a summary of the current status and our new approach:

Reason for the Development Pause: The primary reason for the extended period of silent development was the integration of Unreal Engine 5, which presented significant technical challenges.

New Roadmap & Visuals: We're now outlining our new roadmap, supported by visuals to illustrate our plans.

New Map: The game features a massive, detailed map, which we're dividing into sections for optimization and streaming tests. We're committed to providing frequent updates, allowing the community to follow the development process and provide valuable feedback.
Chicago Region 01 (Development 01): The first section, Chicago Region 01, is currently available within the Development 01 version.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32004930/edae209130dc1e0c69ebf0fb8a95ec5f78bb375b.jpg[/img]

Visual Enhancements: We've made significant improvements to the game's models, shaders, and rendering engine, resulting in a striking graphic structure and stable rendering. A comparison of the old and new rendering is shown in the attached image.

This image is from the old render output.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32004930/031e1fee0f5e79c8708762d5d68620d7862d9474.jpg[/img]

Target Goals: Our target is to activate all high-definition regions of the Chicago map and a significant portion of the gameplay systems by the end of June.

Ongoing Commitment: We are working diligently to achieve these goals and appreciate your continued support.
More screenshots from the current version will be released soon."

notes.title: Unsolved Stories Version 1.0.5.93.is Now Available
notes.content:
WHAT'S NEW

Hello everyone!
This version contains performance optimizations. We have a list of what is changed bellow.

1. The game's content size (textures, models etc) has been reduced to 24GB from 40GB.
We have done this by a compression technology. 

2. Now, we have smooth shadows with long distances. Also we have performance gains by this technique.

distances smooth shadows system video!
https://youtu.be/nNXanYOujO4

3. Our new texture streaming system uses less system and video memory. Which means we gain more system performance by that.

4. We have %50 performance gain by our new loading system on standard HDDs. If you use SSD you can notice the performance improvements.

5. Graphics performance improved by %50 in term of frame per second (fps). But we want to emphasis that our game is still in development.
That means we will improve more.

notes.title: These are Questions and Answers from our support@madhoundgames.com
notes.content:
[b]1 - Which language do you support in the game?[/b]
We should add languages according to sales. You can see a list of sales by a country bellow.
1.United States            (Full Audio	Subtitles)
2.Germany                   (Full Audio	Subtitles)
3.Russian Federation  (Full Audio   Subtitles)
4.Chine                        (Subtitles)
5.United Kingdom        (Subtitles)
6.Japan                        (Subtitles)
7.Turkey                       (Subtitles)
8.Spanish - Spain         (Subtitles)
9.French                        (Subtitles)
10.Korea, Republic of   (Subtitles)	 

[b]2 - Is there a system for character creation/modification in the game?[/b]
There is no character creation mode for story mode.
But we will work on this for online multiplayer mode.

[b]3 - Did you complete the game optimization?[/b]
Loading times are a problem for standard HDD. If you have an SSD, it is not a big deal.
Nevertheless, we will make a performance gain with the virtual texture system.
This system will also allow us to use less system memory.
We're working on that.

[b]4 - Did you complete gameplay systems?[/b]
Content is the king in the game worlds. We prepare a huge map with HQ models.
After that, you will begin to see the gameplay systems we prepared in test environments.
Huge Map Screenshots
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32004930/7e5dad8b1f5a6925d217fc5ada7360cf3203e425.jpg[/img]

[b]5 - Why did you discount that big?[/b]
We wanted to offer a suitable price to who want to support us. We care about your wish lists.

[b]6 - What about traffic and city life?[/b]
This subject is very important for us. We will show you some samples. But it will improve every day.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=hURLhNdwD0o

thanks for your interest
